consoles.description: List of consoles to be managed by conman. Each entry defines a serial console connection.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the protocol command (e.g., '-e ^\' for rsh).

baud.description: Baud rate for serial connections (e.g., 9600, 115200); omit if not applicable.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote device (console server, embedded device, etc.).

log.description: Enable logging of console session data to files in /var/log/conman/.

name.description: Unique name for the console (used as identifier in conman commands).

password.description: Password for authentication (if required by protocol).

port.description: Port number used for the connection (e.g., 23 for telnet, 22 for SSH).

protocol.description: Protocol to use for the connection (e.g., telnet, ssh, rsh, direct).

username.description: Username for authentication (if required by protocol).

defaults.description: Global default key-value settings (e.g., timeout, rshpath, sshpath) applied to all consoles unless overridden.
